Jordan / Kimberly —

Thanks for the index. A few clarifications before we ingest the package:

1) PR sampling: we need author + approver metadata for each PR (can be redacted to role-level if necessary) and a short note on CI-required checks.
2) CI logs: include the build artifact manifest (hashes) and the link between canonical artifact hash and deployed image tag.
3) KMS exports: rotation record + last-successful-rotation timestamp. If you have an HSM attestation or KMS policy snapshot, include that.
4) Change approvals: for emergency patches, include the approver chain and timestamp; we will sample one emergency patch end-to-end.

Redaction guidance: role-level redaction is fine (e.g., "engineer-frontend-1" -> "eng-frontend-001") — do not remove approval timestamps or hashes.

SecureShare link: https://secure-share.acme-sec.com/requests/2389 — please upload the tranche there and mark each file with the evidence-id from your CSV.

If you hit any export limits we can accept a drive share. Thanks — looking forward to the tranche later today.

Best,
Eva Ramos
Senior Assessor — Peninsula Auditors
